currentObservedBehavior: Booking routes validate Idempotency-Key syntax and bind key to a stable hash of user/method/path/body; completed responses can be replayed and mismatched/in-progress keys return conflict.
Payment routes implement claim/complete/release helpers; exact behavior must be validated under concurrent requests.
Safety, ratings, auth, events, support, trips and payouts contain idempotency references; each handler still requires route-specific review.
Payment webhook schema uniquely constrains provider/eventId and stores a payloadHash; NULL/missing provider event identity behavior needs explicit provider contract.
IdempotencyKey.key is globally unique and expiresAt cleanup occurs in selected paths; TTL consistency and cleanup ownership need one approved rule.

requiredInvariants.rule: Same actor + same key + same request returns the recorded logical result without repeating the side effect.
Same key with different actor, route or request content is rejected and not silently reused.
Concurrent duplicate requests result in one authoritative side effect; in-progress duplicates receive deterministic conflict/retry semantics.
Failed/incomplete requests release or mark the idempotency record according to a consistent, documented retry policy.
Payment/refund/wallet/settlement side effect and durable idempotency result are transactionally consistent.
Webhook event deduplication distinguishes exact replay from same-ID/different-payload integrity conflict.
Stored replay response contains only approved client response data and does not expose secrets or mutable privileged state.
Expiry duration, key format/length, namespace/actor binding and cleanup policy are consistent across protected routes.

knownDecisionPoints: Global unique key vs explicit actor/route namespace; current request hash binds request data and actor and should reject cross-owner collisions.
TTL differs across helpers/constants; approve a shared baseline or documented route-specific exceptions.
Stored responseBody privacy and replay authorization must be tested.
Which operations require mandatory Idempotency-Key vs best-effort dedupe must be declared in API contracts.
requiredFinalTests: same event ID with altered payload
